IPT.evidence_source: [/page/9/Text/3] Meanwhile we recommend the use of cognitive-behavioural treatment for depressed children and adolescents, with an early introduction of self-monitoring, social problem-solving and cognitive restructuring.

dxgive.evidence_source: [/page/9/Text/3] Although future research in more homogeneous diagnostic samples will be valuable in the understanding and treatment of child and adolescent depression, 'pragmatic' trials of psychological therapies such as CBT with outpatient youngsters with a variety of clinical conditions may be of equal value to clinicians.
dxgive.warning: The text mentions 'depressed children and adolescents' and 'outpatient youngsters with a variety of clinical conditions' but does not specify if a formal diagnosis was required for all participants or assessed at baseline.
